authentication.key_source: cryptographically random Node-generated per-worker secret passed only to that child process
authentication.signature_covers: all request envelope fields except signature

trust_policy.issuer: must exactly equal the configured OIDC issuer after signature verification
trust_policy.audience: the configured API audience must be present in the verified access-token audiences
trust_policy.unrecognized_verifier_failures: classify as dependency unavailable, not invalid credentials
trust_policy.trusted_context_revisions: tenant and active-membership revisions returned by existing CORE-001 owners must equal the server-derived B2 context; stale snapshots are rejected

limits.json_integer_policy: safe integers only; decimal and fixed-precision values must be encoded as strings

trusted.actor_and_tenant_source: existing Fastify B2 server-derived trusted request context; never caller-provided identity claims

core001.identity.resolve.issuer_policy: provider must exactly match the configured OIDC issuer
core001.identity.resolve.trusted_context_policy: when a full trusted context is present, resolved identityId must equal its actor.identityId

core001.tenant.resolve_context.scope_policy: requested tenant must equal trusted tenant and returned owner tenant must equal requested tenant

core001.membership.resolve.scope_policy: requested tenant, organization and identity must exactly equal trusted context; returned owner scope must match request

response_envelope.context: must exactly echo the authenticated request context

reliability.cancellation: retires and terminates the active worker so an abandoned call cannot be reused
reliability.worker_recovery: a subsequent call creates a fresh authenticated worker
reliability.shutdown: rejects queued work, terminates workers and waits for bounded process exit

mutation_policy.reason: B4 has not yet supplied the approved durable idempotency store and transaction owner
required_before_enablement: B4 durable idempotency identity bound to tenant and operation

ownership_invariants: Python domain logic remains in its existing CORE owners
CORE-001 T03 remains a grant/prerequisite model, not an authorization decision engine
no ACRL dependency is introduced into customer runtime
no public unauthenticated Python HTTP API is introduced
no customer-facing route is enabled by this contract

owner_composition.missing_or_invalid_dependencies: fail closed; the B3 transport does not construct empty or in-memory production owners
owner_composition.production_namespace_policy: Only existing domain/security owners under AUTONOMY_ENGINE may be composed; ACRL continuity runtimes are explicitly excluded.

failure_classes.OIDC_VERIFIER_UNAVAILABLE: JWKS/provider or unknown verifier dependency failure
failure_classes.TRUSTED_CONTEXT_STALE: canonical identity, tenant or membership revision differs from the server-derived context
failure_classes.DOMAIN_RESULT_INVALID: existing canonical owner returned a malformed or out-of-scope result
failure_classes.RUNTIME_TIMEOUT: bounded operation deadline expired; no automatic retry
failure_classes.RUNTIME_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED: request or response HMAC validation failed
